src/auth/connect.ts.boundary: Obsidian store reads, schema/path validation and asynchronous connection effects; no independent pure return calculation remains.

src/auth/credentials.ts.boundary: URL parsing, credential callback and JSON/schema serialization. Origin/path authorization delegates to the verified credentialScope predicate.

src/auth/setup-code.ts.boundary: WebCrypto, random typed arrays, base64, regex and timed encryption/decryption. IEEE-754 expiration arithmetic and cryptographic algorithms are not modeled by this prover.

src/auth/setup-transfer.ts.boundary: Schema/URL validation, thrown errors, current UI store reads and async connection; JSON payload decoding is outside the verified subset.

src/core/activity.ts.boundary: Effect log emission, regular-expression credential redaction, string replacement and Error cause traversal with Set cycle detection. Regex and Error object semantics are outside the translator; tested with credential leakage and nested rejection cases.

src/core/availability.ts.boundary: Effect Schema declarations and construction of a mutable record whose types are inferred from Schema.Type. Schema object inference is outside the translator type model; journal restoration and write recovery are exercised through the selective engine.

src/core/blobs.ts.boundary: Mutable BinaryObjects instances, SHA-1, byte encoding and schema validation. Class heap mutation and cryptographic correctness are not modeled.

src/core/checkpoint.ts.boundary: Effect Schema declaration; no implementation function body.

src/core/config.ts.boundary: Effect Schema decoding and time-dependent defaults. Download setting adapts a number/string union to the verified numeric rule (zero represents unlimited); the translator cannot emit mixed number/string union types.

src/core/content.ts.boundary: Typed-array/base64/UTF-8 codecs, SHA-256 and regex extension parsing. Content equality delegates to verified equalContent; text construction is re-exported from a verified module.

src/core/errors.ts.boundary: Effect exception adapters and runtime instanceof/cause traversal on JavaScript Error instances, including possible cyclic object graphs.

src/core/file.ts.boundary: Yjs document heap mutation, diff library, schema decoding and UUIDs. Comparator delegates to descendingId; no assumed Yjs model is used.

src/core/hash.ts.boundary: Noble SHA-256 and UTF-8 encoding; external cryptographic implementation.

src/core/history.ts.boundary: Yjs snapshots, object identity, random IDs, timestamps, Map aggregation, JSON byte-budget trimming and sort. Empty state and change classification delegate to verified functions. Sort is axiomatic in the pinned translator.

src/core/inventory.ts.boundary: Effect Schema validation, mutable Sets, JSON/UTF-8 codecs and cryptographic object hashing. Inventory path construction delegates to verified inventoryPath. Native byte arrays, cryptographic correctness and thrown schema errors are outside the prover model.

src/core/locations.ts.boundary: Mutable Map/Set graph validation, cryptographic UUID generation, sorted array graph heads, JSON identity comparison and schema-inferred record types. The translator does not model mutable graph containers or UUID freshness; convergence and maintenance reconciliation use real-Git tests.

src/core/metadata.ts.boundary: Schema validation and SyncError throwing around verified migrationSequence and metadataValue. Migration registry is configuration data, not an independently executed function.

src/core/ports.ts.boundary: Legacy snapshot interface used only to validate migration input. No executable logic.

src/core/projection.ts.boundary: Legacy migration validation constructs Yjs documents and hashes decoded content; availablePath resolves case-insensitive collisions using regex suffixes and mutable sets. These byte codecs, regex and Yjs semantics are outside the translator model. No obsolete sync write planner remains.

src/core/protocol.ts.boundary: Effect Schema decoding, RegExp path validation and throwing validation adapters. Full RegExp and Unicode case-folding semantics are not modeled.

src/core/raw-document.ts.boundary: Yjs document mutation and merging, byte codecs, SHA-1 and timeout-bounded diffChars. No axiomatic Yjs convergence or wall-clock timeout model is assumed.

src/core/selective-capture.ts.boundary: Effect reads, mutable journal entries, Yjs baseline branching, UUID generation and byte hashing. Content-change detection depends on cryptographic object references; interrupted writes and oversized local edits have executable coverage.

src/core/selective-context.ts.boundary: Effect filesystem operations and mutable entry, pin, staging and intent sets. Eviction rechecks actual file bytes and protects unsynced/open/pinned entries; the prover does not model filesystem races, disk usage or mutable graph reachability.

src/core/selective-download.ts.boundary: Effect admission and working-space orchestration over file references and mutable cache state. Numeric admission and storage calculations delegate to verified downloadAdmission/downloadSpace; cache availability and I/O are tested at the service boundary.

src/core/selective-engine.ts.boundary: Effect lifecycle, Schema decoding, iterative remote reconciliation, mutable availability and history state. Failure/restart and cross-device behavior are integration-tested; this is not a formal model of asynchronous execution.

src/core/selective-history.ts.boundary: Effect history retrieval with cache inspection, dynamic connectivity, bounded UTF-8 decoding and guaranteed staging cleanup. Schema-inferred snapshots, mutable cache maps and network effects are outside the translator model; offline cache hit and zero-fetch miss are tested through the engine.

src/core/selective-materialize.ts.boundary: Effect admission and filesystem publication, mutable owner maps, schema-inferred intent records and path collision ordering. Size admission delegates to verified downloadAdmission; interrupted materialization is exercised by durable-journal tests.

src/core/selective-merge.ts.boundary: Effect object retrieval, Yjs document merge/rebase and mutable identity adoption after maintenance. Binary conflict decision delegates to verified conflictingBinary. Map/Set operations and schema-inferred records are outside the translator subset.

src/core/selective-ports.ts.boundary: Interfaces only; Effect services, native Uint8Array values and schema-inferred domain types declare adapter boundaries.

src/core/selective-publish.ts.boundary: Effect Git publication, mutable Map batch construction and remote compare-and-swap acknowledgements. Network state, object storage and journal durability are adapter properties, tested against a real disposable Git server.

src/core/selective-writes.ts.boundary: Effect durable-intent protocol and mutable journal records. Filesystem compare-and-swap and process interruption are not represented in the Dafny model; tests interrupt writes and reopen the same saved journal.

src/core/storage-format.ts.boundary: JSON parsing, schema decoding and Effect/SyncError failure behavior; parser semantics are external.

src/core/storage-layout.ts.boundary: Yjs decoding and destruction; resulting layout selection delegates to verified stateLocation.

src/git/catalog.ts.boundary: Effect inventory discovery and bounded Git object retrieval; validates metadata, paths and cryptographic identities. Admission and downloads run through the selective engine. Network I/O, Map traversal and hashing are outside the translator model.

src/git/consolidation.ts.boundary: Effect migration/publication workflow and compare-and-swap Git operations. Bounded snapshot reading is delegated to maintenance-snapshot; revision state decisions delegate to verified publicationState and sameConsolidation. Asynchronous remote behavior is tested against real Git.

src/git/maintenance-snapshot.ts.boundary: Effect orchestration of sequential Git object reads and a mutable snapshot Map. Repository maintenance does not use device download limits. The metadata path predicate is shared with the core path rules; object integrity and snapshot validation remain in the Git and migration layers.

src/git/objects.ts.boundary: Asynchronous just-git tree traversal and mode validation over Map entries; paths delegate to verified safeStoragePath. Promise execution, dependency I/O and tree object graphs are outside the translator model.

src/git/push-lease.ts.boundary: Asynchronous Response decoding and RegExp Git advertisement parsing; remote protocol/transport is external.

src/git/remote.ts.boundary: Effect construction of catalog and maintenance services with URL parsing and validation. Git/network effects are delegated to those services; no status subtree comparison remains.

src/git/selective.ts.boundary: Promise Git tree/object operations and Effect compare-and-swap publication. Managed path checks delegate to the verified hiddenPath predicate. Git object-store and network semantics are not modeled by the translator.

src/git/session.ts.boundary: Promise Git transport and filesystem operations, fetch state and force-push lease handling. Pack eviction inspects native DataView/Uint8Array binary headers; the prover does not model native byte readers or transport lifetime.

src/git/status.ts.boundary: Type-only declaration for the cached vault status; no executable functions.

src/git/vaults.ts.boundary: RegExp storage-layout parser, Set aggregation, sorting and throwing validation; regex and sorting implementation are not proved.

src/main.ts.boundary: Obsidian plugin lifecycle, mutable instance state and Effect/Promise execution. Readiness and outcome decisions are delegated to verified sync-decisions; callbacks remain framework adapters.

src/maintenance/binary-references.ts.boundary: Yjs updates, schema/JSON decoding, binary codecs and mutable blob stores; migration adapters require external library semantics.

src/maintenance/compact.ts.boundary: Yjs recreation, byte/hash conversion and mutable file maps; compaction integrity remains covered by integration tests.

src/maintenance/content-inventory.ts.boundary: Effect migration hooks over isolated Maps and schema-validated repository snapshots. Transformation delegates to the native Yjs inventory builder; no pure independent decision remains.

src/maintenance/device-inventory.ts.boundary: Explicit legacy-to-current migration through Effect Schema, Yjs and raw object Maps. Cryptographic identities and mutable native codecs are validated operationally; legacy decoding remains confined to migration.

src/maintenance/engine.ts.boundary: Effect migration execution, plugin-supplied callbacks, object-identity registry check, RegExp IDs, typed-array cloning and random hash generation. Sequence ordering is verified separately.

src/maintenance/inventory.ts.boundary: Yjs document decoding and lifetime, Git SHA-1 references, mutable snapshot Maps and schema validation. Does not assume a Yjs or cryptographic model in proofs.

src/maintenance/legacy-validation.ts.boundary: Legacy RegExp/schema/JSON/Yjs parsing and binary hash validation. Snapshot and hidden-path checks delegate to verified predicates.

src/maintenance/metadata.ts.boundary: JSON/schema/UTF-8 decoding, legacy Uint8Array conversion, thrown errors and serialization; no trusted decoder axioms.

src/maintenance/previous-validation.ts.boundary: Previous-schema validation used only by explicit migration. Native JSON, Yjs, byte arrays and snapshot Maps are outside the translator model.

src/maintenance/reinitialize.ts.boundary: RegExp vault discovery, Yjs documents, byte codecs and random IDs. Metadata exclusion and hidden-path rules delegate to verified predicates.

src/maintenance/unified-metadata.ts.boundary: Effect migration adapter calling JSON/schema readers and validators; unsupported dynamic unknown objects and external decoding.

src/maintenance/validation.ts.boundary: RegExp/schema/JSON/Yjs parsing and binary hash validation. Snapshot and hidden-path checks delegate to verified predicates.

src/maintenance/vault-storage.ts.boundary: RegExp relocation, JSON/schema recovery, bytes and mutable file maps; no model of parsing failures.

src/platform/activity-log.ts.boundary: Obsidian DataAdapter persistence, Effect Logger callbacks, Schema decoding, bounded arrays of object records and serialized Promise writes. Mutable I/O and schema semantics are tested rather than modeled by the pure translator.

src/platform/consolidation.ts.boundary: Obsidian filesystem I/O, JSON/schema and durable checkpoint replacement. Journal-install safety delegates to verified installableJournal.

src/platform/device-limits.ts.boundary: Converts the schema-inferred Config download MB setting to bytes or Infinity and derives the active storage budget. Config literal unions and JavaScript Infinity are outside the translator type model; settings tests cover finite and unlimited values.

src/platform/device.ts.boundary: OS/platform access, secret storage, UUIDs, Unicode trim and RegExp author sanitization; external environment and regex semantics.

src/platform/git-cache.ts.boundary: Obsidian filesystem adapter, mutable LRU cache, typed arrays, RegExp object paths and Date objects; cache heap and I/O behavior are not modeled.

src/platform/http.ts.boundary: Native Obsidian request serialization, Promise scheduling and deadline races. The transfer slot follows native settlement rather than caller timeout; asynchronous liveness is exercised by a controlled native-request adapter test.

src/platform/lazy-download-views.ts.boundary: Obsidian FileView DOM lifecycle, native onLoadFile reload and themed progress. DOM identity, arbitrary file-type reload and error-panel behavior are exercised by tests; asynchronous native view rendering is outside the prover model.

src/platform/lazy-editor.ts.boundary: Public CodeMirror facets, transaction filtering, Obsidian events and DOM widgets. Editor transaction scheduling and asynchronous file hydration are native runtime boundaries validated in the running Obsidian application.

src/platform/lazy-embeds.ts.boundary: DOM MutationObserver/IntersectionObserver, native metadata link resolution and asynchronous downloads. Browser visibility and image rendering are not modeled; a visible Obsidian embed was checked against a real Git server.

src/platform/retry.ts.boundary: Effect fibers, mutable scheduler state and clocks. retryDelay uses exponentiation and IEEE-754 jitter arithmetic; proving an integer/real approximation would not prove the JavaScript function.

src/platform/selective-vault.ts.boundary: Obsidian DataAdapter and Vault Promise boundaries, UTF-8 codecs, hashing, durable journal replacement and compare-before-write. Native writes and crash durability require adapter tests and live validation, not assumed filesystem axioms.

src/platform/storage.ts.boundary: Throwing adapter around verified safeStoragePath plus asynchronous directory creation; external filesystem semantics.

src/ui/actions.ts.boundary: Callbacks adapt Obsidian plugin methods to UI Promise interfaces; external plugin state and effects.

src/ui/activity-entries.tsx.boundary: React rendering of a flat sequence of structured log records with level icons and native date formatting. DOM and object-record rendering are outside the translator; flat rows, levels and omitted metadata are tested.

src/ui/activity-modal.tsx.boundary: React subscription/rendering, native Obsidian Modal lifecycle, clipboard promises and timestamp formatting. UI and browser APIs are outside the pure translator; tests cover updates, copy field selection and action accessibility.

src/ui/components.tsx.boundary: React/Radix JSX, DOM events and Unicode field naming; rendering and event delivery are external.

src/ui/consolidation-modal.tsx.boundary: Obsidian Modal lifecycle, React rendering, mutable instance state and asynchronous maintenance callbacks.

src/ui/consolidation-panel.tsx.boundary: React hooks, JSX and asynchronous submit callbacks. Checklist acceptance delegates to a verified function; approved copy remains render data.

src/ui/controls.tsx.boundary: Re-exported Radix primitives; no local implementation.

src/ui/diff-highlighter.ts.boundary: Shiki runtime, regex engine and dynamic grammar import; external renderer.

src/ui/file-history-modal.tsx.boundary: Obsidian Modal/React lifecycle and mutable render roots; framework adapter.

src/ui/file-history.tsx.boundary: React JSX/hooks, DOM measurement/scrolling and external diff parsing/counts. History summary, preview values and matching delegate to verified functions; no model of diff library or DOM layout.

src/ui/history-panel.tsx.boundary: React external-store hook and JSX rendering; external event/render semantics.

src/ui/history-view.tsx.boundary: Obsidian ItemView lifecycle and React rendering; constant framework metadata methods have no algorithm to extract.

src/ui/icon-button.tsx.boundary: React JSX/hook/ref and Obsidian tooltip adapter; DOM effects.

src/ui/notice.ts.boundary: Obsidian Notice and DOM icon composition using theme CSS. Framework notification lifecycle and DOM elements are outside the translator model.

src/ui/progress.tsx.boundary: Shared imperative DOM progress renderer and React ref callback. Browser DOM mutation, ARIA roles and CSS animation are outside the translator model; loading-panel and maintenance UI tests cover the shared component.

src/ui/settings.ts.boundary: Obsidian settings metadata and React root lifecycle callbacks; framework-controlled mutable DOM.

src/ui/setup-form.tsx.boundary: React hooks, JSX and event dispatch into setup/maintenance actions; external UI runtime.

src/ui/setup-transfer-modal.ts.boundary: Obsidian modal DOM, QR canvas rendering, timers and encryption/connection Promises; external UI/crypto APIs.

src/ui/store.ts.boundary: Mutable closure snapshot, Partial object patches and listener callbacks; JavaScript identity and notification side effects are outside the pure model.

src/ui/sync-history.tsx.boundary: React JSX/hooks, RegExp search, Intl.Collator sorting and Date-based day grouping. File naming delegates to verified fileName; locale/timezone behavior remains external.

src/ui/sync-issue.ts.boundary: JavaScript Error/SyncError instanceof and bounded cause traversal; user-facing copy is produced by verified issueValue.

src/ui/sync-preferences.tsx.boundary: React JSX/hooks, DOM number parsing and asynchronous persistence callbacks; external UI runtime.

src/ui/sync-status.tsx.boundary: React JSX/hooks, Intl.DateTimeFormat and snapshot field adapters. Status policy, descriptions, colors and blocking delegate to verified functions.

src/ui/use-setup.ts.boundary: React external-store state, schema/URL checks and asynchronous connection callbacks. Saved-credential matching delegates to a verified function.
